summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with loop/thread-id state set and cleared in run_app's try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py (9 tests, all passing when run with PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src). Nothing committed. Caveats: the venv's editable textual install points at a different checkout (base/), so tests need PYTHONPATH override, and without it the suite hangs. Some existing async-fixture tests (test_auto_pilot, test_widget, test_message_pump, test_unmount, test_screens) fail in this environment due to missing pytest-asyncio; I did not verify them against the original code. Full suite not run.
